method_specification.zz_structure_stated.reason: The evidence for this node includes proposal/code/. The plan gives a closed form, H_ZZ=(eps/4)Σ_j(σz_j+1)(σz_{j+1}+1) with K_ij=eps for |i-j|=1, states nearest-neighbour locality and an explicit eps, and the code implements exactly this. The motivation is physical rather than generic: the E–J cell picture as a local ponderomotive, intensity-dependent coupling that drives MI, with citations. It is imprecise, though: it describes the effect as a linear shift eps(n_j+n_{j+1}), while the code's own expansion is eps(1-n_j)(1-n_{j+1}), and the nonlinearity comes from the n_j n_{j+1} term. No Methodology section exists.
